pro.name: Pool Row
pro.blurb: Hop the fences and pools down Pool Row in one clean line.

goals.title: High Score: 15,000
goals.description: Land 15,000 points in one 2-minute run on the Hills.

goals.title: Pro Score: 40,000
goals.description: Land 40,000 points in one run.

goals.title: Hillcrest Bomb
goals.description: Bomb the long Hillcrest hill from top to bottom.

goals.title: Flip the Million Dollar View
goals.description: Land a flip trick in the same combo as the overlook grind.

goals.title: Sick Score: 90,000
goals.description: Land 90,000 points in one run.

goals.title: Golden Hour Combo: 8,000
goals.description: Land one combo worth 8,000 points.

goals.title: Collect S-K-A-T-E
goals.description: S tops Hillcrest Drive, K is over a back yard fence, A rides the ditch, T floats over the spillway quarter pipe, E waits at the bottom of Canyon Road.

goals.title: Five Slices
goals.description: Grab the five pizza slices: two in Summit Court, one on the terrace wall, one over the funbox, one on the overlook rail.

goals.title: Pool Hopper
goals.description: Grab the 1, 2 and 3 coins over the three back yard pools on Pool Row.

goals.title: Secret Tape
goals.description: Find the tape in a hidden back yard pool somewhere near the park.

goals.title: Gap Hunter: 10 gaps
goals.description: Find 10 different gaps around the Hills.

goals.title: Million Dollar Grind
goals.description: Grind for 5 seconds in one go (the overlook rail is long).

goals.title: Cul-de-sac Manual: 5 seconds
goals.description: Hold one manual for 5 seconds.

goals.title: Trick Variety: 5 different tricks
goals.description: Land one combo with five different tricks in it.

goals.title: Gap Rush: 3 gaps in 30 seconds
goals.description: Hit three different gaps inside 30 seconds.

goals.title: Smooth Roller: 5 combos, no bail
goals.description: Land five combos in a row without bailing.

goals.title: Mixtape: find 3 hidden tapes
goals.description: Three skate-video cassettes are hidden on landmark spots. Ride through each one.

goals.title: Pro Challenge Bronze: Pool Row
goals.description: Pool Row: land 2,000 points in the run, and one combo of 800+ points over one of its gaps.

goals.title: Pro Challenge Silver: Pool Row
goals.description: Pool Row: land 9,000 points in the run, and one combo of 2,500+ points over 3 of its gaps, inside 100 seconds.

goals.title: Pro Challenge Gold: Pool Row
goals.description: Pool Row: land 22,000 points in the run, and one combo of 5,000+ points over 5 of its gaps, inside 80 seconds.
